preregistration.research_question: 在保持 T4 sequencing、decomposition、closure、model、seed strategy、scheduler、budget 与 finalization semantics 不变的前提下，completed task artifacts 在最终提交前 deterministic result synchronization 后变为 model-visible 时，其他 agent 是否检查并自然利用这些结果？
preregistration.intervention: add runtime-only result_sync_v1; after every participating agent's initial claimed task is completed, expose the raw completed-task artifacts once to each agent before submission; do not auto-inject evidence into findings, merge, summarize, route, judge relevance, or force reuse
primary_outcomes: R0 foreign completed artifact not visible
R3 used to guide additional reasoning/search
R4 foreign result/evidence incorporated into final security artifact
unchanged_semantics: current decomposition/non-overlap prompt and task lifecycle instruction
model, seed strategy, scheduler, target, evaluator, retry and wall-clock
